**Treasury Accounting and Close**

* Own accounting for FX, hedging, cash and intercompany treasury transactions in Kyriba and SAP.
* Review treasury entries, valuations and interest accruals.
* Lead the monthly close and deliver accurate management accounts and treasury reporting between workday 1 and workday 3.
* Reconcile Kyriba to SAP, resolve differences and maintain complete supporting documentation.
* Support hedge-accounting calculations, statutory reporting, Group consolidation and internal and external audits.

**Intercompany Loans And Cash**

* Oversee accounting and reconciliation for intercompany loans, cash pools and Group funding balances across 102 entities.
* Review loan interest, reference rates and margins against agreements and transfer-pricing requirements.
* Prepare and review loan, cash and bank reconciliation reports.

**Controls and Systems**

* Operate treasury-accounting controls, maintain audit evidence and support control testing.
* Maintain treasury-system master data and support Kyriba-to-SAP interfaces, reporting and process improvements.
* Support regulatory reporting and ensure transactions comply with internal policies and segregation-of-duties requirements.

**Team and Stakeholder Support**

* Act as the subject matter expert and escalation point for Shared Service Centre Treasury Analysts.
* Work with Treasury, Accounting, Tax, Legal, IT, banking partners and international finance teams to resolve issues and support change.

**Essential**
**PROFILE & SKILLS**

* Chartered Accountant, Cost and Management Accountant, ACCA or equivalent finance qualification, with 4–7 years of relevant treasury accounting experience.
* Practical experience of month-end close, reconciliations, FX accounting and intercompany accounting.
* Hands-on experience with an ERP or treasury management system; SAP or Kyriba exposure is preferred.

Strong analytical, reconciliation and control skills, with attention to detail in a multi-entity, multi-currency environment.
  
  

* Clear communication and stakeholder-management skills across Treasury, Finance, Tax, Legal and IT.
* Ability to review work, coach colleagues and manage priorities in a Shared Service Centre environment.

**Preferred**

* Experience in a multinational treasury, in-house bank or treasury shared-services environment.
* Knowledge of cash pooling, intercompany funding and hedge accounting under IFRS 9 or ASC 815.
* Exposure to Kyriba, SAP, Bloomberg, or trade-confirmation platforms.
* Treasury qualification or relevant professional development is desirable.

Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, or a related field, or equivalent experience required. 4+ years of experience in accounting, financial operations, reconciliations, close support, reporting support, or a related field required. Certified Public Accountant (CPA), Chartered Accountant (CA), Association of Chartered Certified Accountants (ACCA), Certified Management Accountant (CMA), or equivalent certification preferred. title: Procurement Risk Analyst
description:
The Procurement Risk Analyst supports procurement and supply chain operations by identifying, analyzing, and mitigating supplier and supply chain risks to ensure business continuity and operational efficiency. This role executes procurement strategies aligned with material buying plans, with a focus on improving supplier performance, capacity readiness, and risk mitigation ahead of demand. The position requires strong analytical capabilities, supplier risk management expertise, data visualization skills, and stakeholder collaboration to provide actionable insights that support procurement decision-making and supply continuity. The analyst will also act as a data steward, ensuring data quality, governance, and consistency across procurement systems.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Analyze supplier and supply chain data to identify risks, vulnerabilities, and potential business impacts, and provide actionable insights to procurement and business leaders.
* Coordinate with sourcing managers, suppliers, and cross-functional teams to assess risks and develop mitigation and business continuity plans.
* Support supplier performance improvement initiatives while maintaining high-quality product and service delivery.
* Monitor supplier capacity, continuity of supply, reputational risks, and margin-related risks, and proactively implement risk mitigation strategies.
* Prepare and present recommendations for process improvements, risk reduction opportunities, and alternative courses of action to procurement leadership.
* Support procurement operations related to supplier onboarding, qualification, contract management, payment issues, and order fulfillment.
* Serve as the communication conduit between suppliers, sourcing teams, and manufacturing facilities during supplier issues or disruptions.
* Provide delivery and expediting support to plants/sites during supplier constraints or operational challenges.
* Support management and execution of engineering releases impacting suppliers.
* Collect, validate, and maintain supplier scorecard data and key performance indicators (KPIs).
* Act as a Data Steward by ensuring data integrity, governance, quality, and consistency across procurement systems.
* Develop dashboards, reports, and automations using tools such as Power BI, Power Automate, Excel, and database systems to improve efficiency and visibility.
* Proactively monitor procurement systems, identify issues, and drive corrective actions to ensure uninterrupted operations.
* Document and share best practices, lessons learned, and continuous improvement initiatives across procurement teams.
* Drive process automation and system enhancements to improve productivity and reduce manual effort.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Supply Base Risk Management: Ability to identify, assess, and mitigate supplier risks related to supply continuity, reputation, and profitability.
* Data Analytics & Visualization: Strong capability to analyze qualitative and quantitative data, identify trends, and present actionable insights using dashboards and reporting tools.
* Procurement Systems Knowledge: Proficiency in ERP and procurement systems such as SAP, Oracle, Ariba, and related purchasing, quality, and payment systems.
* Advanced Technical Skills: Expertise in Advanced Excel (Power Query, Power Pivot, VBA, Macros), Power BI, Power Automate, SQL, and reporting automation.
* Supplier Performance Management: Ability to monitor supplier KPIs, manage corrective actions, and drive continuous supplier improvement.
* Supplier Capacity Management: Understanding of supplier capacity planning, forecasting, and demand alignment.
* Contract Management: Ability to assess contractual terms, monitor supplier compliance, and manage contract lifecycle activities.
* Problem Solving: Strong root-cause analysis and structured problem-solving using data-driven methodologies.
* Negotiation Excellence: Ability to support negotiations to achieve mutually beneficial business outcomes.
* Stakeholder Management: Strong collaboration and relationship-building with suppliers, sourcing teams, manufacturing, and internal stakeholders.
* Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to influence and present insights effectively.
* Escalation & Conflict Management: Ability to manage escalations calmly and resolve issues with minimal business disruption.
* Continuous Improvement Mindset: Ability to identify inefficiencies, implement process improvements, and adapt to changing business needs.
* Agility & Decision Making: Quick decision-making capability with strong business judgment in dynamic environments.

**Experience**

* Minimum 5–6 years of experience in procurement, supply chain analytics, supplier management, or source-to-pay operations.
* Hands-on experience in procurement data analysis, business intelligence, and visualization tools.
* Experience in supplier risk management and business continuity planning.
* Exposure to end-to-end Source-to-Pay processes including supplier qualification, onboarding, contract management, and payment cycles.
* Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams in global or matrix organizations.
* Experience in manufacturing or industrial environments preferred.

**Additional Information**

* Work Location: Cummins India Technical Center (IOC), Pune, India
* Shift Timing: Afternoon / EMEA Shift (12:30 PM – 9:30 PM IST)

title: Senior Financial Analyst
description:
**Senior Financial Analyst**
**Hybrid, Bangalore or Pune, India**
**JOB OVERVIEW**
Legion is seeking a Senior Financial Analyst to help drive disciplined planning, forecasting and decision support across a growing SaaS business. This role will own assigned forecasts and reporting, build scalable financial models, analyze financial and operating performance, and translate findings into clear recommendations for leaders.
  
  
The successful candidate combines strong FP&A fundamentals with commercial judgment, comfort working with SaaS metrics and systems, and the ability to partner effectively with both finance and non-finance stakeholders.
  
  
**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Assist Financial Planning and Analysis Director in managing the strategic planning, budgeting, and forecasting processes.
* Own designated components of the annual budget, periodic forecasts and long-range plan, including assumptions, scenario analysis and consolidation support.
* Develop and maintain driver-based financial models for revenue, headcount, operating expenses, pricing, investments and strategic initiatives
* Deep understanding of SaaS financial and operational KPIs, a strong ability to analyze data to identify trends, actual performance against budget, forecast, prior periods risks, opportunities for growth. Monitor key KPIs and recommend corrective actions.
* Prepare accurate monthly and quarterly management reporting, dashboards, executive presentations and decision-support materials.
* Investigate revenue, cost, margin, and operational variances and explain key business drivers.
* Partner with business functions to evaluate performance and support commercial decisions.
* Perform profitability, pricing, cost-benefit, ROI, sensitivity and ad hoc analyses to support business cases and investment decisions.
* Support month-end and quarter-end closing activities in coordination with accounting teams by reviewing results, validating data and resolving reporting discrepancies.
* Ensure the accuracy, consistency, integrity of financial data and reports through standardization, automation and effective use of finance systems.
* Maintain appropriate financial controls, documentation and data integrity, and support audit or compliance requests related to assigned work.

**REQUIREMENTS:**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field. MBA is required or relevant professional qualification is preferred
* 5+ years of experience in in FP&A, strategic finance, business finance or a closely related analytical finance role in a SaaS, enterprise-software company
* Proficiency with NetSuite required;
* Advanced financial modelling skills, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
* Strong knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, and management accounting , financial statement and operation analysis.
* Ability to synthesize complex financial and operational data into concise insights and practical recommendations.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong attention to detail, problem-solving abilities, and a results-driven mindset.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively across functions.
* Demonstrated commitment to confidentiality, integrity, and professional ethics.
* Experience with BI or data tools such as Tableau, Power BI or SQL, and an interest in using automation or AI to improve finance workflows

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**

* Accuracy and timeliness of budgets, forecasts, and management reports.
* Quality and relevance of financial insights and recommendations.
* Forecast accuracy and variance management.
* Achievement of cost-optimization and profitability-improvement targets.
* Timely completion of financial analyses and strategic projects.
* Stakeholder satisfaction and effectiveness of finance business partnering.

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**
At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a fully remote employer, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry-specific survey data.
  
  
We strive to make competitive offers allowing employees room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position.
  
  
Benefits include, but are not limited to:
  
  

* Health Benefits
* Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
* Parental Leave
* Equity
* Monthly Wellness Reimbursement
* Monthly Lunch on Legion

**ABOUT LEGION**
Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a remote, mission-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission. Legion Technologies delivers the industry’s most innovative workforce management platform. It enables businesses to maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously. The award-winning, AI-driven Legion WFM platform is intelligent, automated, and employee-centric. It’s proven to deliver 13x ROI through schedule optimization, reduced attrition, increased productivity, and increased operational efficiency. Legion delivers cutting-edge technology in an easy-to-use platform and mobile app that employees love. If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling.
  
  
**BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY**
There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3,200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options. Legion’s mission is to turn hourly jobs into good jobs, serving the hourly workers who make up the majority of the US workforce. We believe in empowering employees and helping employers be efficient and innovative by enabling intelligent automation powered by Legion’s Workforce Management platform to optimize labor efficiency and enhance the employee experience simultaneously. Legion WFM was built for the cloud with AI at the core and designed to handle the complexity of modern businesses and meet the needs of today’s hourly employees. Our team is comprised of dedicated individuals from all backgrounds and experiences, globally distributed across all time zones.
  
  
For more information, visit https://legion.co
  
  
**EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY**
Legion Technologies is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, marital status, familial status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, veteran status, and any other legally protected status under federal, state, or local anti-discrimination laws.

title: Senior Financial Planner & Analyst
description:
FP&A / Business Finance
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for a finance professional who can own planning, forecasting, management reporting, business analysis, working capital, and financial modelling in a high-growth environment.
  
  
We hire on
**demonstrated capability, not on credentials**
. The role requires strong financial ownership, analytical thinking, attention to detail, and the ability to translate financial data into actionable business insights.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Planning & Forecasting
* Own the annual operating plan, a rolling 12-month forecast, and driver-based models and business plans built on volumes, pricing, bill-of-material cost and headcount, not last year plus a percentage.
* Management Reporting & MIS
* Own the monthly pack for both entities and the consolidation, covering P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, KPIs and cost centres.
* Prepare sales and cost performance reporting, delivered to a fixed working day.
* Dashboards & Business Reporting
* Build and maintain CEO, CFO, functional-head and investor dashboards.
* Ensure one definition per metric, with controls that prove the numbers tie.
* Cash, Working Capital & Treasury
* Own the cash position statement and short-term cash forecast.
* Track receivables and payables ageing and collections, inventory ageing, DSO / DIO / DPO.
* Manage treasury and investment valuation summaries, along with the overall liquidity and runway view.
* Variance Analysis
* Perform budget vs actual, forecast vs actual, month-on-month and year-on-year analysis.
* Decompose variances into volume, rate and mix.
* Provide the cause, impact and recommended action — not just the number.
* Unit Economics & Pricing
* Analyse profitability by product, segment, customer and geography.
* Build cost structures from bill of material to commissioning.
* Provide deal-level margin support.
* Develop capital-expenditure and make-versus-buy business cases.
* Board, Investor & Fundraising Support
* Support the financial sections of the board pack and investor MIS.
* Build the models, scenarios and diligence data required for a fundraise.
* Market & Competitive Insight
* Conduct market sizing and demand analysis.
* Track competitors and perform benchmarking that informs business planning and pricing decisions.
* Working Capital Improvement
* Drive working capital as an agenda, not just a report.
* Own a tracked improvement programme with named owners across sales, supply chain and procurement.
* Automation & Process Improvement
* Move the reporting cycle from assembly to analysis.
* Use Power Query, a single mapped data layer, and clear documentation so that the reporting process can be independently run by anyone on the team the following month.

What We’re Looking For
  
  
We hire on
**demonstrated capability, not on credentials**
. A
**CA, CMA, MBA (Finance) or CFA**
would be relevant.
  
  
**Core Experience & Capabilities**

* 5 years in FP&A, business finance, management reporting or corporate finance, including an audit or advisory background with a deliberate move into analysis.
* Personally owned a monthly reporting pack for at least twelve consecutive cycles.
* Built a budget or forecast from drivers, not from last year plus a percentage.
* Written variance commentary that senior management acted on.
* Worked directly from a trial balance or an ERP extract, not only from clean data handed over to you.
* Strong advanced Excel and financial modelling skills.
* Power Query, Power BI or SQL is a strong plus.
* Have the instinct to say “this does not tie” before a pack goes out — and hold that line.

Good to Have
  
  

* Recurring ownership of receivables, payables and cash reporting.
* Experience in treasury or investment reporting.
* Multi-entity consolidation and multi-currency experience.
* Experience in manufacturing, hardware or supply-chain-intensive industries.
* Experience with market sizing or competitive benchmarking for a management audience.

title: Associate Manager - Client Reporting
description:
****Responsibilities****
**What Makes This Opportunity Unique**
At Principal Financial Group, we pride ourselves on delivering world-class financial solutions and services. As an Assistant Manager - Client Reporting, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring flawless execution of client reporting and portfolio performance analysis. You will lead a motivated team, direct operations, and have the opportunity to collaborate with top-tier professionals both within our organization and externally. This is a chance to showcase your proven leadership skills and contribute to our ambitious goals while improving your own career growth!
  
  
****Responsibilities****

* Manage daily Client Reporting and Portfolio Performance Reporting to ensure accurate, complete, and timely outputs throughout daily/weekly/monthly/quarterly cycles.
* Direct and mentor a team; set clear objectives, delegate effectively, remove roadblocks, and act as the point of contact for critical issues to ensure timely delivery.
* Partner with Principal Global Investors (PGI) Shared Services, boutique teams, and external collaborators to align requirements, resolve issues, and improve reporting quality.
* Apply strong controls and standard operating procedures to meet regulatory and operational expectations; track metrics and drive continuous improvement.
* Understand front-to-back data flows; work alongside Information Technology (IT) to resolve data issues and stabilize/report through structured huddles and check-ins.

****Key Responsibilities****

* Client and performance reporting activities (35%)
* Plan and coordinate daily/weekly/monthly/quarterly reporting production; ensure accuracy, completeness, and timely delivery according to Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Maintain control evidence, exception logs, and approvals; ensure consistent templates and disclosures.
* People leadership and development (30%)
* Mentor, develop, and motivate team members; provide timely feedback and objective performance evaluations.
* Define roles, delegate work with measurable objectives, manage coverage, and hold the team accountable for outcomes.
* Collaborator partnership and communication (15%)
* Build positive relationships with head office and boutique collaborators; communicate status, risks, and decisions transparently.
* Manage conflicts constructively; ensure clear handoffs with Shared Services and external partners.
* Process improvement, metrics, and planning (10%)
* Contribute to planning and operating model improvements; identify low-value work and streamline workflows.
* Use metrics, huddles, and check-ins to monitor efficiency, quality, and capacity; recommend resource adjustments.
* Risk, compliance, and decision-making (5%)
* Apply operational and regulatory procedures; perform root cause analysis for issues and implement corrective/preventive actions.
* Advance material risks promptly with recommended options.
* Data flow and systems collaboration (5%)
* Chart front-to-back data flows; collaborate with IT and business data owners to address breaks and implement alternative solutions that satisfy reporting goals.

****Qualifications****

* Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, economics, or business (or equivalent) with 10–12 years of experience in investment, asset management, mutual fund operations, or a related field.
* Working knowledge of investment products and services, performance calculation, securities processing, trade life cycle, and corporate actions.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, relationship building, delegation, and presentation skills; diligent and adaptable in changing (VUCA) environments.
* Able to prioritize, make sound decisions, and deliver consistent results under deadlines; open to feedback and continuous improvement.
* Tools/Tech: Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word; collaboration tools (e.g., Microsoft Teams); data visualization (Power BI); performance/reporting platforms (Eagle, Factset); workflow/ticketing tools (JIRA); document repositories (e.g., SharePoint or TBD).

****Skills That Help You To Stand Out:****

* Demonstrated leadership in client and performance reporting operations with quantifiable SLA achievement and quality results.
* Expertise in mentoring teams, setting measurable objectives, and using data-focused huddles/check-ins to manage efficiency and quality.
* Ability to identify data issues throughout front-to-back flows and collaborate with IT to apply lasting solutions.
* Track record in simplifying processes, eliminating low-value work, and scaling standard templates and controls across boutiques/Shared Services.
* Strong approach to handling blocking issues with clear problem statements, root causes, and recommended options.

**Shift Timings: 1.30PM to 10.30PM**

title: Senior Associates – Balance Sheet and Control CoE
description:
**Job Description**

The Senior Accounting Control Associate is responsible for driving the organization's financial governance and control framework through the execution, oversight and continuous enhancement of key accounting controls. This role provides advanced support across balance sheet reconciliations, ASC 606 revenue recognition compliance, journal entry governance, SOX controls, audit readiness, and financial close processes.

The role requires strong analytical capabilities, the ability to independently manage complex accounting control activities, identify and mitigate financial risks and partner with cross-functional stakeholders to strengthen the overall control environment. The Senior Associate is also expected to lead process improvement initiatives, mentor junior team members and support management in ensuring compliance with accounting standards, internal policies and regulatory requirements.

Key Responsibilities

1. Balance Sheet Reconciliations & Account Governance

* Lead the preparation and review of complex balance sheet reconciliations, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timely completion.

* Perform detailed analysis of high-risk and critical accounts, identifying trends, anomalies, and potential control concerns.

* Drive resolution of aged reconciling items and collaborate with business stakeholders to remediate issues.

* Monitor compliance with reconciliation policies, governance standards, and control requirements.

* Support management reviews and provide insights on account integrity and financial risk exposure.

* Coach and guide team members on reconciliation best practices and quality standards.

2. Revenue Recognition Controls (ASC 606)

* Execute and oversee revenue recognition control activities in compliance with ASC 606 and company policies.

* Review complex revenue transactions and supporting documentation to ensure accurate accounting treatment.

* Assess and investigate revenue-related risks, exceptions and control gaps, driving timely remediation.

* Partner with Revenue Assurance, Finance, Commercial, and Controllership teams to ensure compliance and operational effectiveness.

* Support implementation of new revenue recognition requirements, process changes, and control enhancements.

* Provide subject matter expertise on revenue control matters and assist with issue resolution.

3. Journal Entry Governance & Financial Close

* Review and approve journal entries for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with accounting policies.

* Coordinate and support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities to ensure timely reporting.

* Monitor close performance metrics and identify opportunities to improve efficiency and quality.

* Ensure appropriate documentation, review evidence and control execution are maintained throughout the close cycle.

* Support resolution of complex accounting issues impacting financial reporting and close processes.

* Assist management in driving a robust financial close governance framework.

4. SOX Compliance, IPE & Audit Management

* Execute and oversee SOX controls and Information Produced by the Entity (IPE) validation procedures.

* Maintain audit-ready documentation and ensure control evidence meets internal and external audit requirements.

* Coordinate responses to audit requests and support walkthroughs, testing and remediation activities.

* Identify control deficiencies, recommend corrective actions and track remediation to closure.

* Partner with Internal Audit, External Audit, Compliance and Controllership teams to strengthen governance practices.

* Contribute to risk assessments and the continuous enhancement of the control environment.

5. Reporting, Analytics & Continuous Improvement

* Develop and enhance control dashboards, KPIs, and management reporting to support governance oversight.

* Perform trend analysis and identify emerging risks, control exceptions and improvement opportunities.

* Lead automation and process optimization initiatives utilizing technology and reporting tools.

* Drive standardization of processes, documentation and control execution across operating units.

* Support implementation of best practices related to controllership, compliance and financial governance.

title: Credit Strategy & Decisioning Consultant
description:
Credit Strategy & Decisioning Consultant

Location: India

Company: Blue Polaris Inc.

Engagement Type: Consulting / Contractor

Experience Level: Senior

Language Required: English (professional level required)

ABOUT BLUE POLARIS

At Blue Polaris, we are redefining how businesses make decisions. As a global leader in decision automation, AI, and business architecture, we partner with Fortune 500 companies to design intelligent, transparent systems using Decision Model and Notation (DMN) and our proprietary Decisions First™ approach.

We don't just solve problems — we model how organizations think, decide, and act. By combining AI, analytics, business architecture, and human expertise, we help enterprises improve outcomes at scale.

POSITION OVERVIEW

We are looking for a Credit Strategy & Decisioning Consultant — a senior banking practitioner who has personally defined how lending decisions get made. Not someone who built the system that executes the decisions, and not someone who used data science to analyse them. We need the expert who sat at the table where credit strategy was designed: who determined the credit box, defined account management strategy, set the rules for approvals, declines, and counter-offers, and owned the logic that governed how a lender treated its customers across the credit lifecycle.

Your mission at Blue Polaris is to transfer that expertise into our practice. Working directly with our automation architects, you will help us understand how banks and lenders actually make credit decisions — the policies, the strategies, the segmentation logic, the account management frameworks — so we can model that thinking into intelligent, automated decisioning systems that we take to market.

This is an advisory and knowledge transfer role. You are the domain authority. You define what good credit strategy looks like. Our technology teams build it.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

The right person uses language like this naturally:

* "I defined our credit strategy for the personal loan portfolio across acquisition, account management, and collections."
* "I owned the credit box — the eligibility criteria, the risk appetite, the cutoff logic across segments."
* "I designed the account management strategy — when to increase limits, when to decrease, how we treated different risk tiers."
* "I set the rules for how we approved, declined, and counter-offered across different customer segments."
* "I determined how we used bureau data and alternate data to make better credit decisions — not by building models, but by defining the strategy those models were built to support."
* "I worked with data science and analytics teams to tell them what we needed to decision — they built it, I defined what it should do."

The wrong person uses language like this:

* "I built scorecards and ML models to improve credit risk prediction."
* "I implemented the business rule engine and configured the decisioning platform."
* "I used machine learning techniques to improve credit risk outcomes."
* "I was the technical lead on the credit decisioning system implementation."

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Credit Strategy Definition & Knowledge Transfer

* Define and document the credit strategies, account management frameworks, and decisioning logic that governed lending portfolios you have owned or managed.
* Articulate how credit boxes, risk appetite statements, segmentation logic, and underwriting waterfalls were designed and evolved across products and economic cycles.
* Explain the decision logic behind approvals, declines, counteroffers, limit management, pricing, and adverse action — in structured, transferable frameworks that Blue Polaris's automation teams can model and implement.
* Share how you used bureau data, alternate data, and customer behavior signals to inform credit strategy — focusing on the strategic intent, not the technical build.

Account Management & Portfolio Strategy

* Define account management strategies across the credit lifecycle: limit increases and decreases, balance transfer treatments, hardship programs, early intervention triggers, and collections prioritization logic.
* Articulate how portfolio performance analytics — vintage curves, roll rates, EPD, delinquency trends — informed strategic adjustments to credit policy and account management frameworks.
* Share how risk-based pricing strategies were designed and governed, and how pricing decisions were connected to credit risk segmentation.

Go-to-Market & Client Engagement Support

* Contribute to Blue Polaris's capability collateral — helping us demonstrate to banking clients that we deeply understand how credit decisions are made, not just how to automate them.
* Support solution design conversations by acting as the credit strategy voice — explaining what banks actually do and what automation can realistically replace or enhance.
* Review and validate the decisioning frameworks our automation teams build to ensure they accurately reflect real-world credit strategy logic.

REQUIREMENTS

Education:

* Bachelor's degree in finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Master's, MBA, or postgraduate qualification in Finance, Risk Management, or Banking is a strong plus.

Experience — all required:

* 10+ years of experience on the bank or lender side in credit strategy, credit policy, or account management — owning the decisions, not implementing the systems.
* Proven track record of defining credit strategy across one or more retail lending products: credit cards, personal loans, mortgages, auto loans, MSME lending, or BNPL.
* Experience presenting credit strategy recommendations to credit committees, risk committees, or senior leadership and owning the outcome of those decisions.
* Deep understanding of how credit decisions are governed across the full lending lifecycle — from acquisition and underwriting through to account management, collections, and recovery.
* Experience working with data science, analytics, and technology teams to define what credit strategy should do — directing their output, not building it yourself.

Domain Knowledge:

* Credit strategy design: credit box definition, risk appetite, segmentation, underwriting waterfall logic, cutoff management.
* Account management strategy: limit management, balance strategies, hardship treatments, early warning triggers.
* Portfolio analytics interpretation: vintage analysis, roll rates, EPD, loss forecasting — using these to inform strategy, not build the models.
* Regulatory and compliance awareness: understanding how credit decisions must be governed under FCRA, ECOA/Reg B, TILA/Reg Z, UDAAP, or equivalent frameworks.
* Bureau and data strategy: how to use Experian, TransUnion, Equifax, or alternate data providers to sharpen credit decisions — from a strategy perspective.

KEY SKILLS

* Ability to articulate complex credit strategy logic in clear, structured, transferable frameworks — you can explain how you made decisions, not just that you made them.
* Strong communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences — comfortable in a boardroom and in a working session with automation architects.
* Strategic thinking combined with operational depth — you have designed credit strategy and lived with the portfolio consequences of those decisions.
* Collaborative approach to knowledge transfer — you are willing to teach, document, and validate what you know so others can build on it.
* Analytical mindset for interpreting portfolio performance and translating insights into strategic adjustments.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

* Experience across multiple lending products or multiple institutions — breadth of credit strategy exposure is valued.
* Familiarity with decision modelling concepts such as DMN (Decision Model and Notation) or exposure to how credit rules are structured in decisioning engines — from a strategy perspective, not a technical build perspective.
* Experience working in or alongside consulting engagements advising banks on credit strategy transformation.
* Certifications: FRM, CFA, CRMP, PRM, or equivalent risk management credentials.

WHY JOIN BLUE POLARIS?

* Innovate: Your credit strategy expertise becomes the foundation for AI-driven decisioning that transforms how banks lend.
* Global Exposure: Collaborate with Fortune 500 clients and world-class teams across the Americas and beyond.
* Grow Fast: Bridge the gap between deep credit domain knowledge and the future of automated, intelligent decisioning.
* Hands-On Impact: Your thinking goes directly into client engagements — not into a document that sits on a shelf.
* Learn from Experts: Work alongside pioneers in DMN, decision automation, and AI-driven business architecture.
* Remote-First: Work from anywhere in India in a flexible, high-growth consulting environment.
* Make a Difference: Help banks across the globe make faster, smarter, and more consistent lending decisions.

title: Analyst– Research & Financial Analytics
description:
We are seeking a highly analytical and intellectually curious professional to support strategic decision-making through deep financial, company, industry, and competitive analysis. The role requires the ability to transform complex datasets and market intelligence into actionable insights for senior leadership.

The ideal candidate should demonstrate strong financial acumen, structured problem-solving, excellent presentation skills, and the ability to independently drive research projects with minimal supervision.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Financial Analysis & Business Performance**

* Analyze financial statements and business performance metrics, including EBITDA, working capital, return ratios, efficiency ratios, margins, and valuations.
* Build revenue-to-margin bridges and identify key drivers impacting profitability.
* Reconcile financial variances and prepare management-level analytical reports.
* Develop financial models and scenario analyses to support business decisions.

**Company & Industry Research**

* Conduct in-depth research on companies, industries, and market ecosystems.
* Evaluate business models, competitive positioning, technological capabilities, regulatory environments, and growth opportunities.
* Assess industry attractiveness, market structure, pricing power, and profitability implications.
* Analyze operational metrics and connect them to financial performance.

**Competitive Intelligence & Benchmarking**

* Develop comprehensive competitor benchmarking studies.
* Compare peer companies across financial, operational, commercial, and strategic dimensions.
* Normalize datasets for accounting policies, reporting periods, currency impacts, and business models.
* Present actionable insights for strategic decision-making.

**Strategic Analytics & Insights**

* Integrate and reconcile large, fragmented datasets from multiple sources.
* Identify trends, opportunities, risks, and business implications through data-driven analysis.
* Support market sizing, market share estimation, demand-supply analysis, and industry structure assessments.
* Provide recommendations backed by robust analytical frameworks.

**Presentation & Executive Communication**

* Create high-quality executive presentations and strategy decks.
* Develop compelling storylines, key messages, and insightful visualizations.
* Translate complex analysis into clear and concise recommendations for senior management.
* Coach and guide team members on presentation quality and analytical output standards.

**Research Quality & Methodology**

* Critically evaluate market research sources and methodologies.
* Identify limitations, assumptions, and risks within research findings.
* Ensure analytical conclusions are appropriately supported by data and evidence.
* Establish sound research frameworks for strategic projects.

**Dashboarding & Reporting (Preferred)**

* Design and structure multidimensional dashboards for management decision-making.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to define KPIs and reporting requirements.

**Qualification:**

* **CA with 3-4 years of experience**
  **OR**
* **MBA (Finance) with 8-10 years of relevant experience**
  in corporate strategy, industry research, equity research, investment research, ratings agencies, GCCs, consulting firms, or chemical/agri-business organizations.

title: AWS Cloud Sales Operations Executive
description:
1. Job Purpose

The AWS Cloud Sales Operations Executive will manage end-to-end AWS sales operations, customer billing coordination, distributor engagement, margin tracking, discount approvals, payment collection follow-ups, and operational reporting. The primary objective is to ensure accurate and timely billing, maximize AWS commercial margins, reduce revenue leakage, improve collections, maintain customer satisfaction, and support the profitable growth of Enreap's AWS cloud business. The candidate will work closely with AWS distributors such as Crayon, AWS Alliance, Sales, Finance, Presales, Technical, and Customer Success teams.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. AWS Billing and Account Operations

* Coordinate AWS customer billing, monthly invoice generation, verification, and timely invoice submission.
* Maintain customer-wise AWS account IDs, billing details, monthly consumption, invoice references, and payment terms.
* Reconcile distributor invoices, AWS billing reports, customer invoices, credit notes, and adjustments.
* Identify billing discrepancies, incorrect charges, missing credits, and revenue leakage.
* Track AWS account transfers, billing ownership changes, and distributor-related operational requests.
* Maintain accurate records of customer billing arrangements, discount approvals, and commercial terms.

B. Distributor and AWS Alliance Coordination

* Act as the primary operational contact for Crayon and other approved AWS distributors.
* Follow up on AWS billing, distributor margins, credit notes, special pricing, payment adjustments, and account-level issues.
* Coordinate approved customer discount requests and maintain a record of approval validity and commercial conditions.
* Escalate delayed approvals, unprocessed credits, and commercial discrepancies to the AWS Alliance Head.

C. AWS Margin and Profitability Management

* Maintain a customer-wise AWS revenue, distributor cost, discount, credit adjustment, and gross margin tracker.
* Calculate customer-level gross profit and gross margin percentage using approved cost and revenue data.
* Identify low-margin, zero-margin, or loss-making AWS accounts and highlight corrective actions.
* Verify commercial profitability before Sales submits quotations or commits customer discounts.
* Track discount utilization, distributor rebates, and approved pricing benefits.
* Recommend opportunities to improve margins through better pricing, billing arrangements, and approved distributor commercial terms.

D. AWS Payment Collections and Outstanding Management

* Maintain a daily tracker of customer invoices, due dates, amounts collected, and outstanding balances.
* Send payment reminders before and after invoice due dates.
* Share a weekly customer-wise outstanding report with Sales leadership and Finance.
* Follow up with customers on overdue invoices and obtain payment commitments.
* Coordinate payment reconciliation, remittance advice, UTR details, and allocation of receipts with Finance.
* Escalate overdue payments, repeated payment delays, and high-risk accounts promptly.
* Track receivable ageing buckets: 0–30, 31–60, 61–90, and over 90 days.
* Support approved credit-control, billing-transfer, and account-handover processes in coordination with Finance, Sales, and Technical teams.

E. Customer Relationship and Retention

* Respond to customer queries related to AWS invoices, billing, discounts, and account-level commercial information.
* Explain approved billing arrangements and applicable discounts in clear, professional language.
* Coordinate billing disputes and service-related escalations with the appropriate internal teams.
* Maintain customer communication records and follow up until issues are resolved.
* Identify customers at risk because of billing disputes, payment delays, or dissatisfaction and escalate them to the reporting manager.
* Support renewal discussions, customer retention, and expansion opportunities by providing accurate billing and consumption information.

F. AWS Sales Operations Support

* Support the AWS Sales team with quotations, commercial calculations, discount approvals, and profitability checks.
* Maintain an opportunity tracker covering customer name, AWS opportunity ID, stage, estimated monthly recurring revenue, expected margin, and next action.
* Coordinate internal approvals for special pricing, customer proposals, and billing arrangements.
* Support AWS partner opportunity registration and maintain required operational records in ACE/PRM or other applicable partner systems.
* Track customer onboarding, billing activation, account transfer, and handover milestones.
* Help Sales identify expansion opportunities through billing trends, customer consumption growth, and renewal dates.

G. Reporting and Process Improvement

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly AWS operations dashboards.
* Publish monthly customer-wise revenue, cost, gross profit, gross margin, and overdue receivables reports.
* Maintain a centralized tracker for invoices, payment commitments, discounts, credit notes, and distributor escalations.
* Improve reporting accuracy using Excel, pivot tables, lookup formulas, and Power Query.
* Identify repetitive manual work suitable for automation using approved reporting tools and workflows.
* Maintain documentation and audit trails for commercial approvals, invoices, collections, and distributor communications.

H. Internal Coordination and Compliance

* Coordinate with Sales, Finance, AWS Alliance, Presales, Technical, and Customer Success teams.
* Ensure customer commercial commitments align with approved pricing and payment terms.
* Maintain confidentiality of customer billing information and commercial agreements.
* Follow Enreap's credit-control, approval, invoicing, and customer communication policies.
* Escalate material billing risks, potential losses, and overdue collections to management without delay.

**Commercial principle:**
No customer discount, pricing exception, or margin commitment should be finalized without the required internal approval.

3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

**KPI**

**Suggested Target**

Invoice submission

98% or more within the agreed internal timeline

Billing accuracy

At least 99.5%

Billing reconciliation

100% of active customer accounts reconciled monthly

Customer billing queries

Acknowledge within 4 business hours; resolve routine queries within 2 business days

Outstanding report

Updated weekly with 100% of known overdue invoices included

Payment follow-up

100% of overdue invoices followed up according to the collection schedule

Collections

Achieve at least 95% of the agreed monthly collection target, with a stretch goal of 100%

Margin visibility

100% of active accounts have a monthly revenue, cost, and margin record

Commercial approvals

100% of discounts and pricing exceptions supported by required approval

Distributor issue resolution

At least 90% of routine operational issues resolved within the agreed SLA

Reporting

100% of scheduled weekly and monthly reports submitted on time

**Note:**
Targets should be calibrated to Enreap's existing systems, customer portfolio, and baseline performance during the first 30 days.

4. Required Skills and Qualifications

Education and Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Finance, IT, or a related field.
* 1–3 years of experience in cloud sales operations, AWS billing, distributor coordination, commercial operations, or financial operations.
* Experience working with a cloud reseller, managed service provider, IT services company, or cloud distributor is preferred.

AWS and Commercial Knowledge

* Working knowledge of AWS billing, AWS Pricing Calculator, AWS Cost Explorer, and AWS invoices.
* Understanding of AWS partner/distributor billing and discount structures.
* Familiarity with AWS CloudFront pricing, data transfer charges, and applicable discount mechanisms.
* Understanding of monthly recurring revenue, gross profit, gross margin, receivables, and revenue reconciliation.
* Awareness of AWS partner programs and ACE/PRM is an advantage.

Technical and Analytical Skills

* Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including PivotTables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, SUMIFS, and data reconciliation.
* Ability to prepare customer-wise financial trackers and management dashboards.
* Familiarity with Power Query, Power BI, or workflow automation is desirable.
* Ability to understand AWS account structures, billing reports, and basic cloud terminology.

Communication and Behavioural Skills

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Professional customer follow-up and payment collection capabilities.
* Attention to detail and ownership of assigned tasks.
* Ability to coordinate with multiple teams and external distributors.
* Commercial awareness, analytical thinking, and timely escalation of risks.

5. First 90-Day Expectations

First 30 days — Establish control

* Build a verified tracker of active AWS customers, account IDs, invoices, payment terms, discounts, and margins.
* Identify overdue invoices, unresolved billing disputes, missing credits, and accounts with unclear profitability.
* Document the monthly billing and collection process.

Days 31–60 — Improve control and collections

* Implement a standard weekly outstanding report and payment follow-up schedule.
* Reconcile distributor costs against customer billing.
* Flag low-margin and loss-making accounts.
* Establish a tracker for distributor credits and pending approvals.

Days 61–90 — Improve profitability and efficiency

* Deliver a monthly customer profitability dashboard.
* Recommend actionable margin improvements and reductions in revenue leakage.
* Improve collection visibility and reduce avoidable billing delays.
* Automate suitable recurring reports and establish a measurable operations review process.

6. Authority and Approval Boundaries

The executive is responsible for preparing analyses, coordinating approvals, maintaining records, and following up on agreed actions. The executive cannot independently approve customer discounts, change contractual payment terms, commit distributor rebates, waive outstanding amounts, suspend production services, or make representations about data deletion or recovery. Such actions must follow Enreap's authorization matrix and applicable customer agreements and AWS policies.

7. Why Join Enreap?

* Work with an AWS Advanced Tier Services Partner.
* Gain practical experience in cloud commercial operations, billing, alliances, and profitability management.
* Develop exposure to AWS distributor programs and cloud business reporting.
* Contribute directly to customer retention, operational efficiency, and profitable cloud business growth.

**Application:**
Candidates should share their resume highlighting AWS billing, cloud sales operations, distributor coordination, Excel reporting, and payment collection experience.

title: QA Engineer
description:
**About the Role**

This is a QA Engineer role on our Quality Engineering team. You'll be embedded directly alongside a product development pod, owning quality outcomes for that surface area; manual testing and automation are not separate functions here; you'll do both.

You'll report to the QA Engineering Manager and work closely with developers, product managers, and your pod as a real partner in shipping quality software, not a downstream checkpoint.

AI tooling has changed what QA can do day-to-day. We expect you to actively use agentic tools like Claude Code, Kiro, or Codex to help generate and maintain tests. You don't need to have architected pipelines from scratch, but you should be comfortable using these tools as part of your daily workflow.

**What You'll Own**

**Your Pod**

● Serve as the QA owner for your dev pod, test strategy, automation coverage, and quality sign-off for your team's features

● Grow your automation depth and agentic tooling fluency over time

● Take ownership incrementally as you build trust and track record

**Quality Execution**

● Write and maintain test cases across manual and automated coverage for your pod's features

● Help ensure shift-left practices, automation coverage, and clear quality gates are part of the definition of done

● Surface quality risks to your dev team and PM early before code ships, not after

● Track relevant quality metrics for your area: defect leakage, escaped defects, automation coverage, regression stability

**AI-Assisted QA Engineering**

● Use agentic tools (Claude Code, Kiro, Codex, or similar) to help generate test cases, triage CI failures, and maintain regression suites

● Validate AI-generated test output for correctness you're responsible for what ships, even when a tool helped write it

● Bring ideas back to the team on ways AI tooling can speed up testing work

**Automation & Execution**

● Contribute to test plans, sprint readiness, and release sign-off for your area

● Flag capacity risks and blockers early

**Who You Are**

**Must Have**

● **2–4 years of experience in QA or Quality Engineering**, ideally in a fast-moving SaaS product environment (daily/weekly/bi-weekly releases)

● Hands-on experience using AI coding/testing assistants (Claude Code, Copilot, Kiro, Codex, or similar) in your day-to-day work

● Solid coding ability- you can read, write, and reason about code, and contribute to or review test automation frameworks

● Experience with both manual testing and test automation– comfortable moving between the two

● **Backend automation** - hands-on experience building and maintaining API and service-level test automation (REST APIs, databases, messaging) and running it in CI/CD pipelines

● **Web automation**- hands-on experience building and maintaining UI test automation for web applications (Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or similar) and running it in CI/CD pipelines

● Strong communication and partnership instincts with developers and PMs

● Familiarity with shift-left practices- thinking about quality early in the dev cycle

● Comfort with ambiguity - able to take a fuzzy quality goal and turn it into concrete test coverage

**Strong Plus**

● Exposure to agentic QA workflows - self-healing tests, AI-generated regression suites, automated triage

● Background or interest in AppSec or security tooling (SAST, DAST, SCA, integrations)

● Experience testing AI features - understanding of prompting, output validation, hallucination risks

● Experience working in a pod or squad model with embedded QA

**Why You Will Love It**

● Career Growth Opportunities: we promote from within and provide clear progression paths

● Work-Life Balance: flexible hours and hybrid work options

● Collaborative Environment: a culture where people learn from each other

● Employee Recognition: awards, employee of the month programs, and more

● Competitive Compensation: competitive salaries and performance-based bonuses

● Comprehensive Benefits: health insurance for employees and dependents, plus learning and upskilling support

● Diversity and Inclusion: a workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered

title: Manager – Tax, Payroll and Statutory Compliances
description:
**About Dash and the role**
---------------------------

Dash Technologies Inc. is a Dublin, Ohio–based IT staffing and software engineering firm. We place W-2 and 1099 consultants with state, local, education and federal government clients across 28+ states through MSP/VMS partnerships, and we are expanding fast into AI services.

This hands-on CPA role prepares and files every federal, state and local tax and payroll return Dash makes – the person does the work, not supervises it. Each new placement in a new state creates new withholding, unemployment and sometimes local tax obligations, and every public-sector contract depends on Dash staying in good tax standing. The manager keeps Dash filed, paid, registered and audit-ready in every jurisdiction where we operate, with zero penalties and no contract delays caused by tax status.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Federal (IRS) filings**

* Own quarterly Form 941 and annual Form 940 (FUTA), including deposit schedules through EFTPS.
* Produce and file W-2/W-3, 1099-NEC/1099-MISC and 1096 on time; manage corrections (W-2c, 941-X).
* Manage ACA reporting (1094-C/1095-C) if Dash meets the threshold, and support Form 5500 for any retirement plan.
* Prepare workpapers for the corporate income tax return and quarterly estimates; coordinate filing with the external CPA.
* Respond to IRS notices within deadline and keep a notice log to closure.

### **State and local tax filings**

* File state income tax withholding returns and annual reconciliations in every state where Dash has W-2 employees.
* File state unemployment (SUI) quarterly wage reports and payments; track and protest SUI rate notices.
* Manage local and municipal taxes, including Ohio municipal income tax (RITA/CCA and city filings) and other local withholding.
* Handle state business taxes: franchise, gross receipts and commercial activity taxes, sales/use tax and annual reports.
* Monitor nexus as consultants start in new states; open withholding and SUI accounts before the first payroll.
* Obtain tax clearance and good-standing certificates needed for state contract bids, renewals and vendor registrations.
* Respond to state notices and audits; drive penalty abatement where possible.

### **Payroll**

* Run or oversee payroll for internal staff and W-2 consultants across all states, on the agreed pay cycle.
* Reconcile timesheets from VMS/MSP portals to payroll; ensure correct work-state and resident-state withholding, including reciprocity.
* Administer garnishments, benefit deductions, new-hire reporting and year-end payroll close.
* Manage the payroll provider relationship and its tax filing service; verify every agency filing it makes on Dash's behalf.
* Reconcile payroll tax liabilities to the general ledger monthly.

### **Compliance governance**

* Maintain one master compliance calendar of every federal, state and local filing, with owner and due date.
* Keep a jurisdiction register of all tax account numbers, logins and registrations, aligned with the state-registration owner in Pre-sales & Compliance.
* Report monthly to the CEO on filings made, notices open, penalties and upcoming obligations.
* Track rule changes (new state taxes, rate changes, remote-work rules) and brief leadership on impact.
* Support W-9s, tax certifications and SAM.gov tax representations for federal and SLED contracts.

**Qualifications**
------------------

### **Required**

* Active CPA license (US state board), with a Bachelor's or master's in accounting.
* 5+ years of hands-on experience preparing and filing US tax returns – federal, multi-state and payroll – including at least 2 years handling multiple states at once. Candidates who only reviewed or supervised others' work will not qualify.
* Direct experience filing 941, 940, W-2/1099, state withholding and SUI returns.
* Working knowledge of state business taxes (franchise, gross receipts, sales/use) and municipal income tax.
* Track record resolving IRS and state notices and penalty abatements.
* Willing to work onsite in Ahmedabad on the US Eastern Time shift, meeting hard statutory deadlines and owning filings end to end.

### **Preferred**

* Experience in IT staffing or professional services with hourly W-2 consultants placed through MSP/VMS programs.
* Exposure to government contractor requirements: tax clearance certificates, SAM.gov, state vendor registrations.

**Skills, tools and KPIs**
--------------------------

**Skills:** precise and deadline-driven, strong reconciliation skills, clear written communication with agencies and leadership, able to work independently in a small team.

**Tools:** a major payroll platform (ADP, DEEL or similar), QuickBooks or another GL, EFTPS and state tax portals, advanced Excel; ATS/VMS timesheet exports a plus.

title: Commercial Finance Manager
description:
**Job Description**
Job Title : Commercial Finance Manager
  
  
Level : 5A
  
  
**About Us**
With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations.
  
  
Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and setting the standard for our brands, our business and each other.
  
  
Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.
  
  
**Diageo Global Travel**
(“GT”) is one of the most dynamic markets in Diageo, accessing ~2bn potential consumers traveling internationally each year from every corner of the globe. As we emerge strongly from the pandemic, we have redefined our ambition and strategy: to make Spirits the most dynamic and fast-growing category in the travel retail space.
  
  
We are a diverse, entrepreneurial, and agile organisation. Our unique channels include travel retail / ‘duty free’ sales across airport shops, border stores, on-board airplanes, cruises and international ferries.
  
  
For GT to achieve its high-reaching growth and profitability ambitions, we need to transform the way we develop, plan and implement our commercial plans. There is a particular focus required on Commercial Finance (“CF”) to lead the performance agenda and driving balanced, quality growth.
  
  
The Commercial Finance Manager reports directly to the Head of Commercial Finance (APAC and MENA) and has a dotted reporting line to the Account Controllers. The CF team is supported by other finance specialists including FP&A and Financial Control teams based in Budapest as well as an RGM team.
  
  
**Position Overview**
This role maintains relationships with a range of business partners – including Commercial (and wider multi-functional selling) teams, Marketing, FP&A, Internal audit, Supply and our various DBS Shared Services teams across the world.
  
  
You will lead the performance agenda for your customers and support in promoting Diageo’s best interests in all regions and channels. This includes contributing to monthly cluster meetings, understanding the key dynamics of all functions within the business and holding business partners to account for strong performance in their areas of responsibility.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Key Business Partner to GTs Account Controllers and their respective commercial teams:
  
  

* Performance Management: Embeds a strong performance culture within the team, tracking performance against the financial plan (NSV, Operating Profit, Cash) and other critical metrics (including market share and supply chain effectiveness) and proactively managing associated risks and opportunities. This entails:
* Managing the BPM cycle with commercial business partners
* Proactively driving commercial partners to understand external influences and trends and their impact on current/future performance
* Driving possibility thinking in commercial discussions, and managing the development of new customer and brand opportunities
* Quantifying risks and opportunities to the Annual Operating Plan (“AOP”), and communicating these clearly to key stakeholders
* Act as a key business partner to the Account Controllers (Commercial Team) to:
* Drive the commercial performance agenda including planning and customer negotiation strategy that will secure continued value-creating growth
* Drive an effective measurement and evaluation process for investment in the customer alongside the CP&A team
* Support the productivity agenda, including RGM and A&P effectiveness
* Maintain an exemplary controls and compliance environment, working with the Account Controllers and Head of Commercial Finance to:
* Ensure accountability for, and ownership of, the controls environment across the customers
* Ensure all globally mandated CARE requirements are adhered to
* Ensure full visibility of risks and mitigation

**Key Functional Capabilities**
**Commercial Competence and Decision Making**

* Ability to drive value through commercial knowledge/insight and understanding of the impact of decisions on the business

**Strategic Analysis and Financial Modelling**

* Ability to develop, review and present financial analysis/models to address ongoing investment opportunities
* Ability to create insightful analysis, develop/use pricing and margin tools and be a master in how to use these to create and protect value

**Business Performance Management**

* Ability to transition effectively between both operational detail and strategic goals in reviewing ongoing performance
* Ability to identify and track key underlying performance trends – and assess the potential impact of these on performance commitments

**Qualifications And Experience**

* Experience in commercial finance (5 years+)
* Qualified Accountant strongly preferred
* Track record of defining and delivering commercially oriented strategies and plans
* Strong commercial experience and financial competence
* Excellent verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills
* Ability to influence critical commercial decisions.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with a cross-functional team.
* Able to manage multiple assignments and priorities simultaneously
* Fluency in English is critical given the multi country focus

Regular

Gurugram

title: Sr Associate/Assistant Manager- Cost Accountant
description:
Join the dynamic team at Wholsum Foods and be part of an extraordinary movement! Our mission is simple: to change the way the world eats. With brands like Slurrp Farm and Mille, we offer healthy and delicious alternatives to the junk food epidemic. It's time to rediscover the nutritious traditions of our ancestors and embrace the power of millets like Ragi, Jowar, Bajra, and Foxtail Millet.

Led by founders Shauravi Malik and Meghana Narayan, we are food enthusiasts, entrepreneurs, and mothers committed to making a difference. We're expanding globally and seeking talented individuals who thrive in a collaborative, innovative, and high-growth environment. Join us and embark on a rewarding journey where you can grow professionally while having a blast!

At Wholsum Foods, we celebrate diversity and unity, all driven by a shared mission to revolutionize the way we eat. Our team is our greatest asset, and our core values - Relationship First, Dependable, Passionate, and Growth Mindset - bring out the best in each team member. We take pride in being an equal opportunity workplace, embracing individuals regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or gender identity. Together, we will redefine the future of food!

We are also Great Place to Work Certified.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

We are looking for a
**CMA / Cost Accountant**
to strengthen our cost accounting, inventory controls and financial closure processes. The role will focus on
**COGS, product costing, inventory valuation, yield & wastage analysis, cost control and month-end closure**
.

The role will work closely with Finance, Operations and Procurement teams to
**identify cost variances, improve inventory accuracy, strengthen controls and provide actionable insights on product margins and cost efficiency**
. The ideal candidate should have strong analytical skills, hands-on experience with costing and inventory, and a good understanding of ERP/accounting systems.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Product Costing & COGS:**

* Review and validate monthly COGS and product-level costing.
* Analyse standard BOM vs. actual consumption and identify material consumption variances.
* Review changes in raw material, packaging and other input costs and assess their impact on product margins.
* Support standard costing and periodic revision of product costs.
* Analyse product/customer/channel-level gross margins and identify significant cost deviations.

**2. Inventory & Stock Reconciliation**

* Perform monthly closing stock reconciliation between Tally, EasyEcom and operational records.
* Reconcile inventory sub-ledger with the General Ledger and investigate variances.
* Review inventory movements including purchases, production, sales, returns, transfers, adjustments and write-offs.
* Ensure appropriate inventory valuation and accounting treatment.
* Identify and track slow-moving, obsolete, damaged and expired inventory.

**3. Yield & Wastage Analysis**

* Monitor production yield and wastage against standard norms.
* Analyse actual wastage versus standard/approved wastage levels.
* Identify reasons for abnormal wastage and coordinate with operations/procurement teams for corrective actions.
* Track material consumption efficiency and highlight recurring variances.

**4. Expense & Cost Control**

* Review major operating and production-related expenses against budget/previous periods.
* Analyse significant expense variances and provide explanations.
* Ensure appropriate expense provisioning at month-end for goods/services received but invoices not yet received.
* Review provision workings, reversals and utilisation.
* Support identification of cost-saving opportunities and improve overall cost controls.

**5. Month-End Closure**

* Support the finance team in month-end closing activities.
* Prepare/review COGS, inventory, provision and related accounting workings.
* Ensure timely booking of inventory adjustments, provisions and other cost-related entries.
* Perform month-end reconciliations and ensure open reconciling items are tracked and resolved.
* Support preparation of MIS and management reporting related to costs, margins and inventory.

**6. MIS & Variance Analysis**

* Prepare periodic cost and variance analysis for management.
* Analyse actual cost vs. standard/budget/prior period.
* Track gross margin movements and identify key cost drivers.
* Prepare dashboards/reports covering COGS, inventory, wastage, yield and cost variances.

**7. Audit & Compliance Support**

* Provide inventory, costing, COGS and provision schedules for statutory/internal audits.
* Support physical stock verification and reconciliation.
* Ensure proper documentation and audit trail for costing and inventory-related entries.
* Assist in implementing and strengthening internal controls around inventory and cost accounting.

**WHAT WILL YOU BRING?**

* CMA / Cost Accountant – qualified or with relevant experience in cost accounting.
* 2–3 years of relevant experience in cost accounting, inventory accounting, costing or controllership.
* Strong understanding of BOM, standard costing, COGS, inventory valuation, yield/wastage and variance analysis.
* Good Excel and analytical skills, with experience in ERP/accounting systems.
* FMCG / manufacturing/e-commerce experience would be preferred.

**WHAT WILL YOU GET?**

* Opportunity to work with a fast-growing, purpose-driven food brand.
* A collaborative and supportive team culture.
* Growth opportunities and skill-building in a dynamic, high-energy environment.

**Starting Date: Immediately**

**Location: Gurgaon**

Together with partners like J.P. Morgan, Visa, and Wise, we’re building for the next generation of global companies.About The RoleWe’re looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our S&P team and help run the engine behind Aspire’s P&L. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys getting to the bottom of a number and wants to own core finance data processes as the business scales.About The TeamAt Aspire, the Data and Strategy & Planning (S&P) teams sit at the heart of how the company makes decisions. This role sits across both teams, combining rigorous analytical thinking, deep business understanding, and strong technical skills to make sure our financial data is accurate, well understood, and ready to drive decisions. If you’re passionate about using data to shape the future of a high-growth fintech, you’ll feel right at home with us.Key ResponsibilitiesAs a Senior Data Analyst, you will be a key owner of the data behind our P&L and performance reporting. As we continue to expand our business and strengthen our presence in the drone and defense technology ecosystem, we are looking for a driven professional to support our investor relations and fundraising initiatives.

The Role

We are looking for a Fundraising & Investor Relations Associate who can identify relevant investors, establish meaningful connections, initiate conversations, and secure qualified meetings with potential investment partners. The individual will work directly with the CEO and take ownership of the investor outreach process, enabling the leadership team to focus on strategic discussions and investment opportunities.

This is a hands-on role for someone who understands how investment networks work and is confident in engaging with venture capital funds, family offices, private investment firms, HNIs, UHNIs, and strategic investors.

Key ResponsibilitiesInvestor identification and research

● Identify and build a pipeline of venture capital funds, family offices, private investment firms, HNIs, UHNIs, and strategic investors.

● Research investors specializing in defense, aerospace, drones, robotics, deep tech, advanced manufacturing, and dual-use technologies.

● Identify relevant fund managers, partners, investment directors, and other decision-makers.

● Assess investor mandates, investment preferences, sector focus, and portfolio fit.

Investor outreach and networking

● Proactively approach investors through professional email, LinkedIn, telephone, industry networks, and referrals.

● Introduce Maverick Drones and communicate its business proposition using approved investor materials.

● Build and maintain a pipeline of potential investors and develop long-term professional relationships.

● Follow up consistently and convert initial outreach into meaningful investor conversations and meetings.

Fundraising execution

● Schedule and coordinate investor meetings directly with the CEO.

● Manage investor communication from initial outreach through follow-ups, meetings, and subsequent discussions.

● Maintain an organized investor database and track interactions, responses, and next steps.

● Coordinate investor information requests and due-diligence activities with internal teams.

● Provide regular updates on investor engagement, pipeline progress, and upcoming meetings.

Investor relations and transaction support

● Assist in preparing pitch decks, company profiles, investor presentations, and supporting financial information.

● Conduct preliminary industry, market, and comparable-company research where required.

● Coordinate with external advisers, investment bankers, and other fundraising intermediaries.

● Identify relevant networking events, investment forums, and strategic opportunities to expand the company's investor network.

Who We’re Looking For

**Practical investment exposure matters more than academic credentials.**

We are particularly interested in candidates who have practical exposure to investment banking, venture capital, private equity, startup fundraising, investor relations, or financial advisory.

Preferred qualifications and experience

● Approximately 1–4 years of relevant professional experience.

● Demonstrated exposure to investor outreach, fundraising, deal sourcing, investment research, or financial advisory.

● Candidates with established professional networks among investors or investment professionals will have an advantage.

● An MBA in Finance, CFA qualification, or other relevant financial qualification is desirable but not mandatory.

● Strong candidates with a bachelor's degree and relevant practical experience are encouraged to apply.

Essential skills

● Excellent communication, networking, and relationship-building abilities.

● Confidence in approaching senior professionals, fund managers, and investment decision-makers.

● Strong professional email writing, presentation, and follow-up skills.

● Ability to research investors and identify suitable investment opportunities.

● Familiarity with Excel, PowerPoint, LinkedIn, and investor research tools.

● Basic understanding of corporate finance, equity investments, valuation, and fundraising processes.

● A proactive, persistent, and results-oriented approach to work.

What Matters Most in This Role?

We are not looking for someone whose primary strength is financial modelling or reporting alone. We want someone who can find the right investors, reach the right decision-makers, initiate conversations, build relationships, and get qualified meetings scheduled with the CEO.

Candidates who can demonstrate real investor access, networking ability, and fundraising execution skills will be given preference over candidates who possess academic qualifications without relevant practical exposure.

Compensation and Incentives

● Fixed annual compensation: ₹6–7.2 LPA.

● Performance incentive: Highly attractive, success-linked incentives upon successful completion of investment transactions.

● Location: Kolkata, West Bengal.

● Employment type: Full-time.

● Reporting to: CEO.

**Attractive Success-Linked Incentives:** In addition to the fixed annual compensation, the role offers highly lucrative incentives linked to successful investment transactions. We believe in rewarding meaningful contributions to the company's growth, and the right candidate can expect significant upside for successfully facilitating investment opportunities.

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹55,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Internet reimbursement
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
