title: Senior  Tax & Compliance Analyst - VCS
description:
What You'll Do
  
  
The Senior Analyst, VCS plays a critical role in strengthening the accuracy, scalability, and AI-enabled execution of Avalara’s U.S. Voluntary Compliance Services (VCS) operations across multiple jurisdictions and complex client environments. As client complexity, historical exposure, and voluntary disclosure volumes increase, this role ensures consistent SLA performance, reduces compliance and penalty risk, and embeds AI-driven workflow improvements that enhance productivity and quality. This individual contributor is expected to operate as a Bar Raiser, elevating execution rigor, mentoring junior analysts, and applying AI in measurable ways to improve speed, insight, and operational scale across the VCS lifecycle (from transactional data intake and nexus validation through data manipulation, analysis, processing, and reporting of historical returns prepared for filing).
  
  
**#Hybrid**
**What Your Responsibilities Will Be**
**How This Role Elevates Avalara**

* For Customers Delivers high-accuracy, on-time preparation of historical Sales & Use tax returns for filing — through data manipulation, analysis, processing, and reporting — across multiple jurisdictions, along with voluntary disclosure submissions, proactively mitigating exposure to penalties, interest, and audit risk.
* Acts as a senior point of contact for customers and their project managers, and as liaison with state taxing authorities for state voluntary disclosure / amnesty programs, providing clear status communication and documentation that help customers understand risk remediation and the outcome of their VCS engagements.
* For the Business Improves operational leverage by: Reducing manual effort in transactional data validation, reconciliation, pSTRA preparation, and notice handling.
* Standardizing VCS status, nexus, and exposure reporting. Accelerating turnaround for large historical scopes and complex multi-state disclosures.
* Supports margin and discount discipline by minimizing re-work, return revisions, and avoidable escalations.

**For The Team Raises Talent Density Through**

* Mentorship and coaching of juniors on VCS standards, nexus and exposure judgment, and client communication. Structured review and quality control discipline for voluntary compliance spreadsheets and historical returns.
* Sharing templates, SOPs, and AI-enabled best practices that uplift the whole team.
* For Our AI-First Strategy Improves turnaround time per voluntary disclosure / historical project.
* Increases accuracy and consistency across returns, disclosure spreadsheets, and periods. Raises analyst productivity and independence by leveraging AI-enabled workflows already defined for the team.

**Responsibilities (Outcome-Based Ownership)**

* Own end-to-end preparation, processing, analysis, and quality assurance of historical Sales & Use tax data and returns for multi-period, multi-jurisdiction VCS engagements — including custom pSTRA, Tax Summary Reports, and voluntary compliance spreadsheets submitted to state taxing authorities — so returns are accurate and ready to be filed, delivering ≥99% accuracy and 98–100% on-time SLA adherence.
* Independently manage complex reconciliations and variance analysis between client transactional data, prior filings, and proposed disclosure returns, including altering or adding transaction data where required while maintaining clear audit trails.
* Serve as the senior primary point of contact for customers and their project managers, and as liaison with state taxing authorities for state voluntary disclosure / amnesty programs, owning sensitive negotiations and status conversations.
* Maintain a 24-hour turnaround time for critical client escalations and compliance inquiries related to voluntary disclosures, historical returns, notices, or exposure questions.
* Demonstrate deep understanding of complex, historical transaction-level data and U.S. Sales & Use tax law, ensuring data is accurately validated, troubleshot, transformed, and reported — including nexus setup — so historical returns and disclosures are prepared and ready to be filed.
* Improve document and data retrieval turnaround time by 15–25% using AI-supported research, pattern recognition, and tracking tools.
* Standardize weekly VCS status, nexus, risk, and exposure reporting using AI-enabled formatting and summarization tools.
* Identify and implement at least one scalable AI-enabled workflow enhancement within the first 6 months, with clear measurement of productivity or quality impact.
* Manage relationships with customers, project managers, state taxing authorities, and internal/external Avalara partners throughout the VCS lifecycle to ensure alignment on scope, timelines, risks, and outcomes, including proactive de-escalation through direct customer calls when needed.
* Mentor I1/I2 analysts in independent case handling, nexus and exposure analysis, high-quality documentation, client-ready narratives, and effective, compliant AI usage.
* Maintain and continuously improve SOP documentation for VCS (data intake, nexus validation, reconciliation, pSTRA preparation, disclosure submission, return preparation for filing, notice handling, and closeout) aligned to client contracts, jurisdictional rules, and Avalara standards.
* Provide proactive support to CAMs and Sales to help drive successful voluntary compliance and remediation sales cycles, including answering scoping questions, joining key client calls, and providing clear, data-backed delivery perspectives.

**AI Bar Raiser Expectations**

* The Senior Analyst, VCS must demonstrate exceptional applied AI capability that produces measurable operational impact, not just experimentation.
* This includes: Embedding AI tools into transactional data cleansing and enrichment, reconciliation and variance explanation, nexus and historical exposure summaries, pSTRA preparation, and VCS escalation workflows.
* Quantifying impact (e.g., time saved per engagement, reduction in manual review hours, improved turnaround time per disclosure period, fewer rework cycles).
* Applying AI responsibly while exercising professional judgment, especially for compliance-sensitive topics such as taxability, nexus determinations, exposure estimates, and final return values. Sharing AI best practices (prompts, workflows, validation steps) to elevate team capability and embed them into SOPs.
* Continuously identifying automation opportunities aligned to efficiency, risk reduction, scalability, and consistent client experience.
* Casual or convenience-based AI usage does not meet Avalara’s AI Bar Raiser standard.

**12-Month Success Signals**

* Within 12 months, the Senior Analyst, VCS will demonstrate: Sustained ≥99% preparation accuracy across their VCS portfolio (returns prepared for filing, disclosure spreadsheets, amendments, and corrections).
* 98–100% on-time performance for agreed VCS SLAs, including during peak workload and complex multi-state disclosures.
* 15–25% reduction in document and data retrieval turnaround time through AI-enabled research, tracking, and templated requests.
* Measurable reduction in re-work and re-opened engagements via robust validation controls, better upstream scoping, and AI-supported checks.
* At least one implemented AI-driven workflow enhancement (e.g., automated variance narratives, pSTRA/template builders, data-mapping accelerators) delivering quantifiable productivity gains.
* Documented AI and process best practices adopted across the VCS team and incorporated into SOPs.
* Strong independent handling of complex escalations, including high-exposure periods, nuanced jurisdictional and nexus rules, and sensitive client and state-authority scenarios, with minimal senior intervention, including proactive de-escalation through direct client calls and clear, solution-focused communication.

What You’ll Need To Be Successful
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Commerce, Accounting, Taxation, Finance, or related field; or MBA in Finance.
* 3–4+ years of U.S. indirect tax / Sales & Use tax compliance experience, ideally including voluntary disclosure, amnesty, or remediation programs.
* Demonstrated experience managing multi-jurisdiction return portfolios and handling compliance escalations (e.g., notices, penalty and interest issues, nexus questions).
* Advanced MS Excel proficiency (complex formulas, pivot tables, macros/VBA, large data-set handling) and demonstrated ability to work with complex historical transaction data to prepare accurate disclosures and historical returns ready for filing.
* Proven experience using AI tools to improve operational speed, quality, or scale (for example, in data analysis, documentation, or reporting workflows).
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex historical tax, nexus, and exposure topics in clear, client-friendly language to customers, project managers, and state taxing authorities.
* AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.
* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

Avalara is an AI-first Company
  
  
AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.
  
  

* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

How We’ll Take Care Of You
  
  
Total Rewards
  
  
In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.
  
  
Health & Wellness
  
  
Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.
  
  
Inclusive culture and diversity
  
  
Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.
  
  
**What You Need To Know About Avalara**
We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.
  
  
We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.
  
  
We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.
  
  
**We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer**
Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

title: Litigation Manager (4-5 years)
description:
**Position Overview**

Delhivery is looking for a law graduate with 4–5 years of relevant litigation experience to join its Litigation team in Gurugram. The role involves independently managing litigation filed by or against Delhivery across India — commercial, recovery, labour, consumer, civil and criminal matters — including reviewing notices received, drafting and vetting replies, notices, written statements and evidence, and formulating and recommending strategy on the way forward for current and existing matters. The candidate will monitor all pending litigation; coordinate with internal business and ground teams to gather evidence and inputs for replies, notices, written statements and other court/tribunal filings; and manage and coordinate with external counsel, including assigning new matters and overseeing how they are handled. The ideal candidate will have sharp legal acumen and the ability to strategise, and will be resourceful, organised and people-oriented, with strong follow-up skills and the ability to manage cases independently with minimal supervision.

**Key Responsibilities**

***1. Litigation Management & Drafting***

• Independently manage and respond to commercial, recovery, labour, consumer, civil and criminal matters across India; review notices received and draft, vet and finalize replies, notices, written statements, pleadings and evidence before filing.

• Take the call on assigning matters to external counsel, driving litigation strategy, filings and hearings, and proactively flag risks and escalations to management.

• Track litigation timelines, monitor court proceedings, maintain accurate, up-to-date trackers and ensure timely resolution of issues such as AR attendance, document filing and orders with external counsel.

***2. Evidence & Internal Coordination***

• Coordinate with internal departments (HR, Security, Finance, Revenue Assurance) and business/ground teams to obtain accurate data and factual inputs; manage, protect and collate evidence for use in replies and pleadings.

• Draft responses independently or route them to counsel, and review counsel's drafts for accuracy and alignment with the company's position before filing.

• Act as the primary liaison between the Litigation team, internal stakeholders and external counsel; drive timely documentation, appearances and compliance across functions.

***3. Counsel & Court Coordination***

• Coordinate with external counsel for hearings, filings, conferences and documentation, representing the Litigation team's interests throughout.

• Facilitate execution of affidavits, vakalatnamas and authorisations, and coordinate attendance of company representatives and witnesses before courts and authorities, ensuring adequate preparation.

***4. Strategy, Team & Operations***

• Strategise and advise business teams on legal escalations and potential litigation, recommending a course of action based on risk assessment; identify recurring issues and recommend process or policy changes.

• Own day-to-day litigation operations, calendars, document repositories, litigation reports, counsel invoices and court-fee approvals and drive improvements in tracking and document management.

**Qualifications & Experience**

• LL.B. from a recognised university or institution.

• 4–5 years of relevant litigation or litigation-management experience (in-house or law firm) across commercial, recovery, labour, consumer, civil or criminal matters.

• Demonstrated experience independently managing litigation end-to-end, with minimal supervision.

• Familiarity with court procedures, particularly in Delhi/NCR.

• Proven experience coordinating with external counsel and internal stakeholders on case strategy.

• Ability to independently navigate court and tribunal websites.

Bar Council enrolment preferred.

**Key Skills & Attributes**

• Sharp legal acumen with strong drafting and reviewing skills across notices, pleadings and evidence.

• Resourceful, proactive and solution-oriented, with the confidence to own matters and a small team independently.

• Strong analytical ability and sound judgment in assessing litigation risk and strategy.

• Excellent follow-up skills and the ability to drive closure of action items across stakeholders.

• Clear, confident communication skills, both written and verbal.

• High level of organization, attention to detail and ownership.

• Ability to manage multiple matters, a small team and competing priorities under pressure.

Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and litigation trackers; high integrity and professionalism.

title: Company Secretary
description:
You will serve as the Company Secretary for SATL and GTCI, ensuring strong corporate governance, regulatory compliance, board management, statutory filings, investor relations, and secretarial operations for a listed entity and group companies in India.
  
  
**Job Summary**
As the Company Secretary for Goodyear South Asia Tyres Private Limited and Goodyear Technology Centre India Private Limited, you will support the end-to-end corporate governance, regulatory compliance, and secretarial functions for a listed entity and two group companies in India. You will partner with leadership, legal, finance, and external stakeholders to ensure compliance with the Companies Act, 2013, SEBI regulations, stock exchange requirements, and best-in-class governance standards.
  
  

* Corporate Governance & Compliance
* You will ensure compliance with the Companies Act, 2013, SEBI (LODR) Regulations, and other applicable statutory requirements for a listed company and two group companies in India.
* You will support the implementation and monitoring of corporate governance frameworks, policies, and compliance practices.
* You will track regulatory changes and advise relevant stakeholders on compliance implications.
* You will demonstrate strong knowledge of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, Related Party Transactions, Dividend regulations, Insider Trading regulations, Takeover Code, Materiality requirements, and other applicable regulatory provisions.
* Board, Committee & General Meetings
* You will support the planning, coordination, and execution of Board Meetings, Committee Meetings, and Annual General Meetings.
* You will prepare and circulate agendas, board packs, notices, resolutions, and supporting documentation.
* You will draft, finalize, and maintain minutes and records in accordance with statutory and regulatory requirements.
* Statutory Filings & Regulatory Reporting
* You will ensure timely filings with the Registrar of Companies (RoC), SEBI, and Stock Exchanges.
* You will prepare and submit periodic disclosures, quarterly and annual filings, annual returns, and other regulatory reports within prescribed timelines.
* Secretarial Documentation & Records
* You will maintain statutory registers, records, and corporate documentation as required under the Companies Act and SEBI regulations.
* You will support the preparation of AGM Notices, newspaper publications, annual reports, and other statutory communications.
* Investor Relations & Shareholder Services
* You will manage shareholder communications and coordinate with the Registrar & Transfer Agent (RTA).
* You will respond to investor queries and shareholder grievances in a timely and effective manner.
* You will support dividend-related activities, including declaration processes, payments, and unpaid dividend management.
* Postal Ballot & IEPF Compliance
* You will manage the end-to-end postal ballot process and related secretarial compliances.
* You will ensure compliance with Investor Education and Protection Fund (IEPF) requirements, including transfer of shares, unclaimed dividends, and related filings.
* Insider Trading & Internal Compliance Systems
* You will manage and monitor internal compliance tools and Code of Conduct systems.
* You will ensure compliance with the SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations and maintain all related records and disclosures.
* Cross-Functional Coordination
* You will work closely with legal, finance, and other internal teams to ensure alignment on compliance and governance matters.
* You will support the implementation of compliance calendars, governance processes, and internal control mechanisms

**Experience**

* You should be a qualified Company Secretary (CS) with 8+ years of post-qualification experience in corporate secretarial, governance, compliance, and regulatory affairs functions.
* You have hands-on experience working in a listed company environment, with strong exposure to the Companies Act, 2013, SEBI (LODR) Regulations, SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, Related Party Transactions, Takeover Code, and corporate governance requirements.

Goodyear is one of the world's largest tire companies. It employs about 63,000 people and manufactures its products in 48 facilities in 19 countries around the world. Its two Innovation Centers in Akron, Ohio, and Colmar-Berg, Luxembourg, strive to develop state-of-the-art products and services that set the technology and performance standard for the industry. For more information about Goodyear and its products, go to www.goodyear.com/corporate
  
  
Goodyear is an equal employment opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any characteristic protected by law.

title: Senior Family Office Service and Compliance
description:
**Gurnani Family Office (Marken Capital) | Gurugram | In-office**

Experience: 10+ years

**About the Family Office**

**Marken Capital**
is the single-family office of the C.P. Gurnani family and operates as a sub-entity within the family operating business,
**Assago Group.**

The family office manages capital across public markets, private companies and external managers,

alongside the family's wider financial and administrative affairs, including cross-border structures, group companies, real estate, trusts and succession planning.

**The Role**

This role
**anchors the service and compliance function of the family office**
—
**family-office operations, cross-border compliance, banking, tax, portfolio administration, entity governance and family engagement.**
This is not a conventional back-office role. It involves cross-border filings, entity administration, portfolio data integrity, and the working relationships with the banks, advisors and fund managers the office depends on.

The role requires someone
**who can take ownership without constant supervision, understand when to act independently and when to escalate, and bring structure to complex financial and administrative matters.**

The successful candidate will become a key operating partner to the family and will provide functional oversight and coordination across the family-office operations team.

Family-office experience is preferred but not essential. Strong candidates from private banking service and compliance, Big Four compliance or tax, or similar multi-entity financial operations roles will also be considered.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Banking, Onboarding and Asset Consolidation**

* Run KYC and re-KYC cycles across all entities and family members, in India and offshore.
* Manage digital onboarding onto new investment platforms and funds; map and consolidate assets across banking relationships.
* Handle fund drawdowns, capital calls and distributions — tracking notices, arranging payment and confirming credit.

**Portfolio Data & Reporting**

* Own the family office reporting platform — historical data migration, position tagging and valuation reconciliation across custodians.
* Collect and reconcile monthly statements across roughly a dozen institutions — private banks, wealth platforms, PMS managers and AIFs.
* Prepare consolidated cross-asset portfolio reviews and strategic insight summaries for family decision-making.

**Tax, Trust & Succession**

* Coordinate ITR filings and entity financials with the family CA.
* Manage advance tax, trust administration and reporting cycles with the offshore trustee and administrator.
* Support domestic and overseas trust and will formation for succession planning.
* Assemble cost-basis and transaction history across two decades of holdings.

**Stakeholder Management**

The role coordinates a wide external network — private bankers, custodians, wealth advisors, execution partners, Big Four advisors, the family CA, offshore corporate secretaries, fund managers and trustees. Keeping these parties aligned and to timetable is a
**substantial and continuous part of the work.**

**Cross-Border Transactions & Compliance**

* Manage reporting and compliance for the family's
  **offshore investments**
  , drawing on a working knowledge of overseas investment regulations.
* Administer the
  **Liberalised Remittance Scheme (LRS)**
  across family members — tracking utilisation against annual limits per individual, preparing Form A2 and supporting declarations, coordinating remittances with the authorised dealer bank, and maintaining the audit trail for overseas investments and offshore accounts.
* Manage
  **offshore entity compliance**
  for the group structures — annual returns and AGMs, IRAS tax filings, statutory records, and coordination with the corporate secretary and tax agents.
* Liaise with the
  **auditors**
  and external advisors to ensure compliance with all applicable statutory and regulatory requirements.
* Lead LLP formations and administration for new investment vehicles, including ROC filings and related secretarial work.

**Real Estate and Group Companies**

* Oversee property documentation, mutation processes and developer payment schedules.
* Support group company matters including share certificates, board records and transaction
* documentation.

**Family Engagement**

* Serve as a
  **trusted operational point of contact for family members**
  on financial, administrative and investment-related matters.
* Communicate clearly and proactively, particularly where multiple advisors or institutions are involved.
* Maintain at least one in-person meeting or interaction each month with senior family members.

**What We Are Looking For**

**Experience**

* 10+ years in a single or multi-family office, private banking service and operations, Big Four compliance or tax, or a similar multi-entity financial operations role.
* Familiarity with property documentation and mutation processes, and with company secretarial records. This is an additional requirement not mandatory.

**Core Attributes**

**Ownership**
: Takes responsibility from initiation through completion.

**Organisation:**
A high standard of personal organisation, and comfort bringing structure to complex, multi- party processes.

**Judgement:**
A clear sense of which decisions sit with the role, which belong to the family, and which require a professional's sign-off.

**Attention to detail:**
Comfortable working with financial records, regulatory filings, entity structures and historical transaction data where accuracy is critical.

**Composure**
: Steadiness under a calendar of statutory deadlines that do not move.

**Communication:**
Able to communicate comfortably with family members, senior advisors, bankers, lawyers, accountants and investment professionals.

**Discretion:**
Absolute confidentiality is non-negotiable. The role involves access to highly sensitive family, financial, investment and personal information.

**Apply at hr@assagogroup.com**

**Job Title:**
Specialist, Financial Operations

  
  

**Role:**
This role aligns with industry titles such as Contract Analyst, Contract specialist, or Contract reviewer analyst (legal)

  
  

Role Purpose

  
  

The Specialist, Contract Operations is an experienced individual contributor responsible for the accurate, timely and controlled processing of complex contractual information across global businesses. The role combines hands-on contract analysis and system expertise with quality assurance, issue resolution, stakeholder partnership, and technical guidance to colleagues. It supports consistent contract operations from agreement receipt and interpretation through data entry, approval, archival and downstream readiness.

  
  

**Role Value**

  
  

Protects contractual and financial data quality, strengthens operational controls, resolves complex processing issues, and enables reliable royalty and rights administration.

  
  

**Key Accountabilities**
**1.**
**Contract Analysis and Processing**

  

  
* Review, interpret and process executed agreements, amendments and supporting documentation, including complex commercial, rights and royalty terms.
  
  
* Validate contract and financial data before approval, ensuring that information entered by colleagues is complete, accurate and aligned with the underlying agreement.
  
  
* Apply sound judgement to identify ambiguous, conflicting or adverse clauses and route matters to the appropriate business, legal, portfolio or operational stakeholder for resolution.
  
  
* Ensure contract records and supporting documents are accurately indexed, archived and readily retrievable.
  

  

**2.**
**Quality Assurance, Controls and Service Delivery**

  

  
* Perform quality checks and approvals in line with documented procedures, delegated authority and segregation-of-duties requirements.
  
  
* Monitor assigned work against service levels, turnaround expectations and operational priorities, taking timely action where delivery or data quality is at risk.
  
  
* Comply with standard operating procedures, control requirements, data retention standards and privacy obligations.
  
  
* Identify control gaps, recurring errors and operational risks, document findings and recommend practical corrective or preventive actions.
  

  

**3.**
**Data Integrity and Systems Expertise**

  

  
* Maintain accurate, complete and dashboard-ready contract data across relevant operational regions and systems.
  
  
* Use contract and rights management platforms effectively, applying strong knowledge of system dependencies and downstream impacts.
  
  
* Support data remediation, reconciliations, system testing and process changes where contract expertise is required.
  
  
* Maintain auditable trackers and records that provide clear status, ownership and evidence of completion.
  

  

**4.**
**Complex Query Resolution**

  

  
* Own complex contract-processing queries through to resolution, completing appropriate investigation and maintaining a clear audit trail.
  
  
* Provide accurate and timely guidance to Contract Operations, Portfolio, Rights, Royalties, Finance, Technology and other relevant stakeholders.
  
  
* Escalate material contractual, control or delivery risks with clear facts, impact assessment, options and recommended next steps.
  

  

**5.**
**Technical Leadership and Continuous Improvement**

  

  
* Act as a subject-matter resource for contract interpretation, processing standards, controls and systems within the Contract Processing Hub.
  
  
* Coach and support colleagues through knowledge sharing, peer review and practical guidance, without direct people-management accountability.
  
  
* Contribute to the maintenance of procedures, training materials, checklists and control documentation.
  
  
* Use root-cause analysis and operational insight to simplify processes, reduce avoidable rework and improve quality, consistency and stakeholder experience.
  
  
* Support automation and transformation initiatives by translating contract requirements into clear business rules, test scenarios and acceptance criteria.
  

  

**6**
**. Stakeholder Partnership**

  

  
* Build effective working relationships across global and regional teams, communicating complex issues in a clear, concise and commercially aware manner.
  
  
* Influence outcomes within agreed authority, balancing contractual accuracy, control requirements, service delivery and business needs.
  
  
* Participate in operational reviews and cross-functional forums, providing evidence-based updates and following actions through to closure.
  

  

**Decision-Making and Scope**

  

  
* Works independently within established policies, procedures, controls and delegated authority.
  
  
* Handles varied and complex work where solutions require analysis, interpretation and the application of specialist knowledge.
  
  
* Makes recommendations on contract treatment, operational risk and process improvement, escalating matters that require legal, commercial or policy decisions.
  
  
* Operates across multiple global business areas and adapts priorities in response to changing volumes, deadlines and stakeholder requirements.
  

  

**Experience and Qualifications**

  

  
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Legal Studies, Commerce or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
  
  
* Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in contract administration, rights and royalties, finance operations, legal operations or a comparable processing environment.
  
  
* Demonstrated experience reviewing complex agreements, maintaining high-quality data and working within structured service and control frameworks.

title: Company Secretary

SN Capital Management Pvt. (Official Page) is a financial consultancy and treasury solutions firm specializing in strategic financial instruments for a diverse client base. The company provides wealth management, investment banking, corporate finance and advisory, as well as brokerage and distribution services across equities, commodities, mutual funds, structured products, insurance, corporate deposits, bonds, and loans. Serving institutions, corporations, high-net-worth individuals, and families, SN Capital Management combines market expertise with robust risk management practices. With a strong in-house technical team and the trust of over 3,000 clients, the firm focuses on helping clients build wealth through equity, pre-IPO, and unlisted share opportunities. Candidates joining the organization can expect a performance-driven, client-focused environment with exposure to complex financial products and advisory work.

The Company Secretary will be responsible for ensuring compliance with corporate laws, securities regulations, and internal governance standards, while supporting the board and management in decision-making. Day-to-day tasks include preparing and maintaining statutory registers and records, drafting minutes of board and general meetings, and coordinating filings with regulatory authorities such as the Ministry of Corporate Affairs and relevant stock or securities bodies. The role also involves advising on corporate restructuring, monitoring changes in legal and regulatory frameworks, and implementing best practices in corporate governance. The Company Secretary will collaborate with finance, legal, and senior leadership to manage shareholder communication, support audits, and oversee documentation for corporate actions and investments. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Noida.

* Professional qualification as Company Secretary (CS) from the Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI), with strong knowledge of Companies Act, SEBI regulations, and other applicable corporate laws.
* Experience in corporate governance, board secretarial work, and compliance management within financial services, investment banking, or wealth management environments.
* Proficiency in drafting and reviewing legal and corporate documents, including board minutes, resolutions, agreements, and statutory filings.
* Strong analytical and risk-awareness skills for interpreting regulations, assessing compliance implications, and supporting complex financial and corporate transactions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively with board members, regulators, auditors, and internal stakeholders.

* Prior experience in a NBFC, investment firm, or consulting/treasury solutions company is an advantage.

description:
Prasanna Law Chambers (PLC) is a law chambers based in Delhi/NCR that specializes in a wide variety of Criminal Cases. The firm and its associates handle matters across Delhi/NCR and focuses on Trial Court and High Court Practice. Please only apply if you are comfortable travelling to Noida Sector 127 and stay in office till 8:30 PM.

**PLEASE NOTE BEFORE APPLYING AND APPLY ONLY IF YOU CAN FULFIL AND COMFORTABLE WITH THE FOLLOWING:**

* **Apply only if you are committed to work in the hardcore Criminal Litigation- Trial Court and High Court. If you have basic understanding of criminal law and some experience in trial court work.**

* **The work includes visiting jails of Delhi, meeting clients there and visiting all the trial courts of Delhi.**

* **The office is in Sector 127 Noida and we are in office usually till 8:30 PM, so apply if you are comfortable with the timings and working at the said location. Preference would be given to someone living in Noida.**

* **Please do not apply if you are looking for short term work, since in litigation you need to spend substantial time to learn basic of trial, therefore, if you are willing to work for 2-3 years minimum, you are welcome to apply.**

* **If you are comfortable with challenging work of criminal trial including cases related to murder, NDPS, UAPA, MCOCA, POCSO, Cheating etc. - which involves drafting, research, cross examination and arguments in courts.**

**Role Description:**

This is a full-time on-site role for a Litigation Associate at Prasanna Law Chambers located in
**Noida, Sector 127 (near to HCL & Amity Law School).**
The Litigation Associate will be responsible for handling day-to-day tasks associated with litigation in various courts in Delhi/NCR, including:

* A to Z brief of the matter, preparation of list of dates, Drafting of Bail Applications, Misc. Applications, Revision Petitions, drafting of divorce and other matrimonial related matters. Detail research on matters including proper preparation of Criminal Trial Matters, finding case laws, preparing for cross examination, and representing clients in courts, including arguments. Research and preparation for Arguments in High Court.

* Filing of cases, obtaining vakalatnamans from Jails and other related misc. work of court.

* Good drafting skills and prior experience in drafting is mandatory.

* If you have the right skills, you get the liberty to handle the matter A to Z (including arguments and Cross Examination) with all the guidance from the seniors and other colleagues.
